output.headline: Write-down approval workflow keeps breaking wherever the new status reaches

what_keeps_breaking.point: Basic limits on a write-down were missing: a line could be written below zero.
The approval threshold was not enforced at first, so a 40% write-down was finalised without review.
Status transitions around approval are wrong: proposals stay Awaiting approval after the write-down is removed, and an earlier approval survives a further write-down over the limit.
Approve and Reject were not restricted to the billing manager role, so a project manager approved her own write-down.
Rejecting write-downs cleared the lines but left the written-down total in place.
Other code paths did not know about the PendingApproval status: the open-proposal check let a second proposal be created, and the status label showed the raw enum name.
The approver and clerk saw wrong or missing information: the approvals list showed 0.00 with no reasons, and the clerk got no message that approval was needed.
The audit log recorded every change as 'Adjustment' rather than Write-up or Write-down, which weakens audit evidence.

output.why_it_escapes: There are no automated tests for this rule, and every fix added either a manual case or nothing, so the PendingApproval status introduced by BILL-1159 was never exercised end to end across finalise, approvals, proposal creation, labels and audit. The material also conflicts on the approver: the code requires a billing manager, while the ontology says large write-downs need the engagement partner, and the rule statement BR-07 does not state a threshold or approver at all; the material does not settle which is correct.

proposed_tests.title: Write-down larger than the line is refused
proposed_tests.scenario: On a proposal line of 500.00, write down by 600.00 with a reason. Expected: refused with 'A write-down cannot take a line below zero.' and the line stays at 500.00.

proposed_tests.title: Write-down over 10% blocks finalisation
proposed_tests.scenario: On a 12,000 EUR proposal for P-1001, write lines down by 4,800 EUR with a reason, then Finalise. Expected: status Awaiting approval and Finalise refused with the billing manager approval message.

proposed_tests.title: Removing the write-down releases the approval
proposed_tests.scenario: On a 10,000.00 proposal, write a line down by 2,000.00 (20%), then set the adjustment back to 0. Expected: status returns to Proposal and Finalise succeeds.

proposed_tests.title: Project manager cannot approve or reject
proposed_tests.scenario: As Sofia Berg (project manager), open Approvals and approve, then reject, her own 20% write-down. Expected: both refused with 'Only a billing manager can approve write-downs.' / '...reject write-downs.' and status stays Awaiting approval.

proposed_tests.title: Approvals list shows amounts and reasons
proposed_tests.scenario: With one 10,000.00 proposal written down by 2,000.00 with reason 'Overrun', open Approvals as a billing manager. Expected: amount before 10,000.00, written down 2,000.00 and the reason 'Overrun' shown.

proposed_tests.title: Awaiting approval status is labelled readably
proposed_tests.scenario: Open a proposal written down by 20%. Expected: status shown as 'Awaiting approval', not 'PendingApproval'.

proposed_tests.title: No second proposal while one awaits approval
proposed_tests.scenario: With a P-1001 proposal Awaiting approval, try to create another proposal for P-1001. Expected: refused and no second proposal exists.

proposed_tests.title: Clerk is told approval is needed
proposed_tests.scenario: Write a 10,000.00 proposal down by 2,000.00 (20%). Expected: message 'Adjustment saved. The proposal now needs a billing manager's approval.'

proposed_tests.title: Reject restores lines and totals
proposed_tests.scenario: On a 10,000.00 proposal written down by 2,000.00, a billing manager rejects the write-downs. Expected: no adjustment on the lines, total back to 10,000.00 and status Proposal.

proposed_tests.title: Further write-down clears an earlier approval
proposed_tests.scenario: A billing manager approves a 15% write-down on a 10,000.00 proposal; the clerk then writes another line down so the total is 30%. Expected: status Awaiting approval again, approval cleared and Finalise refused.

proposed_tests.title: Audit log distinguishes write-ups and write-downs
proposed_tests.scenario: Write one line down by 100.00 and another up by 50.00, then open the audit log. Expected: entries with action 'Write-down' and 'Write-up' respectively, not 'Adjustment'.
